svg.title: Milestones completed: counts, remaining goals and checklist percentages
svg.desc: A separately defined overall roadmap and five local checklists, not code or effort completion. Separate validation pass rates and exact done criteria are available in the linked Markdown ledger.
svg.text: ROCK MAN x64 / LIVE CHECKLIST TRACKER
Accepted roadmap milestones + named delivery checklists.
Reviewed 2026-10-24 / CHANGES COMPARED WITH THE PREVIOUS RECORDED REVIEW
5 bounded foundations accepted; 15 production goals remain.
Unequal-size milestones — NOT 25% of game/code/effort finished. Effort-weighted progress is unknown.
7 named criteria · version 1 · bounded Linux / Windows delivery
BLOCKER Real launcher, pixels and actual-capture display remain unverified.
NEXT Obtain permitted real-launcher and actual-capture GUI evidence.
4 named criteria · version 1 · data-only components, not a controller
BLOCKER No Windows execution or real endpoint/capture/UI integration.
NEXT Review the production endpoint and lifecycle contract before connection.
4 named criteria · version 1 · selected native-policy checkpoints only
BLOCKER Initializer execution preparation remains blocked pending review.
NEXT Resolve the existing review gate; do not retry blocked preparation.
4 named criteria · version 1 · necessary gates, not a sufficiency proof
BLOCKER All four necessary gates remain open; S2 controls stay disabled.
NEXT Establish a bounded loading contract, then owner retirement and integration.
1 named criteria · version 1 · one acceptance gate, not implementation %
BLOCKER A0:49 remains unresolved; full native startup is unestablished.
NEXT Resolve service effects and their permitted implementation basis.
Pass rates for specific suites — not milestone or game completion
Checklist goals have different sizes. Do not add these percentages. A checked goal means only its cited scope passed.
Native boot remains unestablished. S2 is NO-GO. The chart is regenerated by the approved documentation workflow.
